name: Timecode Bar Shortcuts
description: Injects customizable one-click shortcut buttons into the timeline toolbar's flex gap (between the history-forward arrow and the snapping/skimming controls). Which actions appear is configured from the SpliceKit Settings tab or via JSON at ~/Library/Application Support/SpliceKit/timecode_bar_shortcuts.json. Survives SpliceKit patcher updates.
author: SpliceKit
